note: G6's own recall sets: each term is matched as whole words after the text is normalised (g6.guards' folding, Unicode NFKC, format characters such as zero-width spaces removed, every character that is not a letter or digit made a space, runs of spaces made one, lower case); the terms are normalised the same way. The terms name ideation, intent and disclosure only; none names a method. Terms marked added_for_review were added after the first review. Each term carries a near miss: a sentence that shares its words and is not a crisis, with whether the trigger fires on it. One that fires is a known false positive, kept because missing a person in crisis costs more than a false alarm. An exception is its own rule: it covers only its own words, so any trigger phrase beside it still fires. No qualified person has reviewed any term or exception.
